hotspots.title: Trump Midterm Rally Frenzy
hotspots.blurb: President Trump's relentless campaign swing through key states including Texas, Nebraska, and Maryland commands major coverage as the midterms draw closer. Packed rally venues, high-profile shipyard appearances, and controversial public remarks continue to energize his base while driving intense news cycles.
hotspots.affect: The high frequency and provocative rhetoric of Trump's public rallies spark intense base enthusiasm and sharp partisan contention.

hotspots.title: Trump‑Funded Ad Controversy
hotspots.blurb: A $20 million DNC lawsuit challenging the Trump administration's use of taxpayer funds for political promotional ads sparked swift pushback and a strategic retreat, with MAGA Inc. taking over costs. The administration continues to defend the campaign, creating a prominent political and legal fight.
hotspots.affect: Allegations of taxpayer misallocation provoke intense ethical debate and defensive political maneuvering.

hotspots.title: Immigration Crackdown & Migrant Policy
hotspots.blurb: The Trump administration is expanding its immigration crackdown with an unprecedented denaturalization push and plans to use government lawyers for unaccompanied minors. These efforts face pushback in federal court, where a judge blocked $1.8 million fines against noncitizens.
hotspots.affect: Aggressive executive action combined with active judicial intervention generates deep moral debate and ideological outrage.

hotspots.title: Vance Alaska Rally Surge
hotspots.blurb: Vice President JD Vance conducted a targeted campaign blitz across Alaska to rally support for vulnerable Republican incumbents. His Fairbanks rally and local appearances focused heavily on bolstering GOP prospects in tight midterm contests.
hotspots.affect: High-level executive intervention in competitive congressional races highlights strategic urgency and base mobilization.
